github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text:
Use conventional commit format: <type>[(scope)]: <Subject>

[optional body]

[optional footer(s)]
Use types: feat, fix, docs, style, ref, test, revert, chore, ci, build, perf, git
Separate subject from body with a blank line
The subject should use the imperative mood, be capitalised, short, clear, concise, descriptive, meaningful, and communicate the context surrounding a change
Limit the subject line to 50 characters
Do not end the subject line with a period
The body should explain what and why vs. how
Use the footer to reference breaking changes with 'BREAKING CHANGE: <description>'
Use the footer to reference issues with 'Closes #<issue-number>'
Use the footer to reference links that may exceed 72 characters with 'More: https://very.long.link/lorem-ipsum-excepteur-anim-dolore-et-laborum-officia-nostrud-nisi-tempor-in.-Sint-laboris-ex-ea-ex/'
Follow the constraints defined in the gitlint configuration, in order of precedence: .gitlint, ~/.config/gitlint/gitlint.cfg
